requirements.quote:
A non-validating security-aware stub resolver MAY include the DNSSEC
   RRs returned by a security-aware recursive name server as part of the
   data that the stub resolver hands back to the application that
   invoked it, but is not required to do so.
requirements.condition: A non-validating security-aware stub resolver receives DNSSEC RRs from a security-aware recursive name server and returns data to the application that invoked it.
requirements.required_behavior: MAY include the returned DNSSEC RRs in the data handed back to the invoking application; including them is optional.
requirements.why_checkable: The application-facing response can be inspected to determine whether the optional DNSSEC RRs are included; either inclusion or omission is permitted.

requirements.quote:
A non-validating security-aware stub resolver MAY include the DNSSEC
   RRs returned by a security-aware recursive name server as part of the
   data that the stub resolver hands back to the application that
   invoked it, but is not required to do so.  A non-validating stub
   resolver that seeks to do this will need to set the DO bit in order
   to receive DNSSEC RRs from the recursive name server.
requirements.condition: A non-validating security-aware stub resolver seeks to include DNSSEC RRs received from the recursive name server in the data returned to the invoking application.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the DO bit to receive the DNSSEC RRs from the recursive name server.
requirements.why_checkable: When the resolver is configured to obtain DNSSEC RRs for application delivery, its outgoing query to the recursive name server can be checked for a set DO bit.

requirements.quote:
A validating security-aware stub resolver MUST set the DO bit,
   because otherwise it will not receive the DNSSEC RRs it needs to
   perform signature validation.
requirements.condition: The stub resolver is validating and security-aware.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST set the DO bit to obtain the DNSSEC RRs needed for signature validation.
requirements.why_checkable: Queries emitted by a validating security-aware stub resolver can be inspected for a set DO bit.
